prompt: Pink bakes a giant birthday cake
title: Giant Birthday Cake
irony: Pink says yes to every wish until the giant birthday cake grows too big to share, so one small no is what finally lets everyone say yes to cake.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun fills the big-house kitchen where Pink lifts a giant mixing bowl beside Green and Navy.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants the biggest birthday slice and lists dinosaur candles while Pink says yes to every extra flavor.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lilac arrives with her rule book and warns the batter is rising too fast for the small oven.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Everyone gathers round the wobbling giant cake and sings the birthday chant together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Jade dares Green to frost the top while the wobbly layers tilt and cherries slide down.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Pink adds more cream and cherries till the giant tower leans and plops frosting on Lilac.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Everyone steadies the leaning cake and sings the birthday chant louder together.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Pink confesses with Blue and Gray that always saying yes has made the cake too big.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Pink says one small no to more toppings and Green cheers to carry the cake to the square.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crowd in the sunny square sings round the giant cake as Pink serves the first slice.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Morning sun fills the village square where everyone shares cake and Navy hugs Pink.
